 Cookie Haus is the fifth game announced for The Jackbox Party Pack 11 . It is a drawing game where players are given cookies to decorate according to the customers' specifications.

 Gameplay [ ] 

 The game consists of 4 rounds. During each round, players have to choose a cookie shape, draw on it and name it. In the first and second round, this is according to a topic selected for the players. In the third round, the topic has a blank to be filled by the players. In the fourth round, players modify a cookie created in a previous round instead of choosing a new cookie shape. Each round after all players submit their cookies, they vote for their favorite cookies and score according to the number of votes received.

 Cookie Haus (stylized as COOKIE Haus ) is a party video game and one of five games featured in The Jackbox Party Pack 11 . 

 Gameplay

 Everyone will have a round cookie to decorate on their device to set as their profile picture to start with.

 In the first round and second rounds , a customer will walk in and request a type of cookie that'll follow a prompt (like, things found in your dreams, for example) . The players will then be prompted to first select a cookie shape that they'd wanna ice over, with the top two always being labelled as "challenge cookies"—then, they'll decorate the cookie by either changing the color or brush size of the icing, adding sprinkles, or changing the cookie's color. After their decorated cookie is finished, they'll have to give their cookie a name.

 When all cookies have been submitted, two of them will be paired off, and the others will have to vote on which one they think is their favorite, with a choice to give them a like if they desire. When the votes are tallied up and shown, bonuses will be given out for their respective challenges, which are, in ascending point order:

 A Good Sport Bonus worth 10 points for every time they give kudos to the other player's cookie; which, additionaly, gives 50 Kudos Bonus points to the other player.

 A Speedbaker Bonus worth 25 points if the player manages to send in their cookie in 90 seconds or less; additionally, if the player finishes in 60 seconds or less, they'll earn a Super-Speedbaker Bonus , which doubles the bonus' worth.

 A Like Bonus worth 25 points per like that cookie has been given.

 A Challenge Shape Bonus worth 50 points for selecting a cookie labelled as "challenge" in the cookie selection screen.

 A Baker's Duo Bonus worth 50 points if their cookie gets matched up in a three-way match-up. This bonus is only applicable in 5– and 7–player games. 

 A Weekly Special Bonus worth 100 points if a player's cookie utilizes one of the seasonal sprinkles seen in the game.

 A "Most Votes" Bonus worth 100 points if their cookie managed to earn the most votes out of the match-up.

 An Audience Bonus worth 100 points for the cookie who got the most Audience votes.

 A U-NOM-imous Bonus worth 250 points if the player's cookie manages to earn all of the voting player's votes.

 When all votes and bonuses are given out to each player, their scores are summed up and the next match-ups will be shown. Once all of the match-ups are finished, the scores are shown on-screen.

 The third round will consist on a fill-in-the-blank prompt, which will prompt the players to name their cookie with an answer that could fill in the missing line from the prompt given; the voting phase will work the same as the others.

 The fourth and final round will have a returning customer from the first round come back in and ask the players to skew their decorated cookies in a certain way (like making them more dangerous, "normal", etc.) , which will give the players the three top-scoring cookies from that round and they'll have to ice over them in order to fit the given prompt.

 Once all the rounds are over, the final scores are tallied up and the winner with the most amount of points by the end of the game will be declared the winner.

 Development

 The game's basic premise was first unveiled during the Jackbox Games Direct on April 7th, 2025 [ 1 ] , where it was also revealed that the game would be directed by Chase McClure , making it his directorial debut.

 The game was officially announced as Cookie Haus on August 7th, 2025. [ 2 ] 

 The design team for the game are as follows:

 Chase McClure - Director and Lead Jackbox.TV Engineer

 Kyra McJesse - Producer

 Liz Anderson - Lead Editorial

 Mira Swor - Lead Gameplay Engineer

 Steff Egan - Lead Artist

 Andy Poland - Audio Lead and Product Owner

 Alex Lueck - QA Lead

 As part of the free content update for The Jackbox Party Pack 11 (released on November 20th) [ 3 ] , Cookie Haus gained the following new features:

 Brand new customers, prompts, and cookie shapes.

 A new special sprinkle that is updated every week, themed to a weekly holiday, such as Tasteful Stretch Denim Week. [ 4 ] 

 The customer's name now appears above their speech bubble.

 When a unanimous vote occurs during a voting round, Moonique will respond with a quip. (e.g. "Total cookie knockout!")

 When decorating a cookie from earlier in the game, you will see the original cookie next to your updated design.

 Numerous performance and bug fixes.

 Trivia

 The customers' reactions directly relate to the amount of points the winning cookie has earned.

 One of the spinkle options available features the selectable avatars that are present in Quiplash 3 .
 Along with this, there are also cookies that are shaped like the Nerd from Trivia Murder Party 2 , and Chuck Hull from Joke Boat .

 There are several Easter eggs that appear when a player decides to enter a specific name for their cookie, these are:
 "I lose"—deducts 500 points and adds "You lose!" to the receipt.

 "Poop" or "Fart"—deducts 10 points and adds "Uh oh, stinky!" to the receipt.

 "I frew up"—gives a 5-point and adds "Poor baby!" to the receipt.

 Adding a name of one of the Jackbox staff members gives 10 points and adds "Thank" to the receipt.
 However, mentioning Mira Swor in the name of your cookie—more specifically, typing in "Mira is cool!"—gives a 69-point bonus and adds "Haha.. Yeah.. Wow.." to the receipt.
